scope: Technical entry-point test; route semantics chosen only for verification
dictionaryMode: Attributed M008 Wiktionary cache fixture, not a new live acquisition
scenarios: Two draft concepts each receive two designations, Wiktionary senses 1 and 5 with revision; two manually confirmed routes preserve distinct IDs and directed contexts
Search shows both IDs, all lexical sources, incident edges and directed context in the usage inspector, without automatic identity
Published correspondence edits retain designation ID; add/remove changes only the chosen mapping; republishing a stale initial draft preserves all operator edits
Missing/network-unavailable meanings keep manual correspondence and optional manual provenance editable
A second definition reuses the same concept and ordinary edge IDs; all aliases are editable at the reused field; reopening the first draft does not reset the dictionary
Actual server process restart and GUI export/import into a separate clean database preserve mappings, sources, graph structure, drafts and original history
K001/K002/K003 historical SQLite states and all original revision bytes match the verified recoverable backup
